basic_details.short_information: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham has announced 83 vacancies on a contract basis for the posts of Robotics Engineer, Senior Research Assistant, Research Trainee, Marketing Staff and More, with the place of posting in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, Coimbatore-TN, Kollam , Keralam. Qualifications and eligibility requirements vary by post as specified in the official notification. Eligible candidates can apply online at the Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham job portal, and applications can also be sent by email. The last date to apply is 31 October 2026.

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: All Posts: No specific age limit is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates of eligible academic backgrounds may apply.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham for various postdoctoral research fellow, Research Trainee, Robotics Engineer and More positions across multiple engineering disciplines at their Coimbatore campus in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 83 vacancies available for various Postdoctoral Research Fellow positions, with one vacancy allocated for each specialization.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for these positions is 31 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the AI in Power and Energy Systems post?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, along with demonstrated expertise in machine learning, deep learning, or data science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification needed for the Hydrology/Water Resources fellowship?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Post-Doctoral Research Fellow in Hydrology/Water Resources must have a Ph.D. degree in Water Resources Engineering, Hydrology, or other closely related fields.

faq.question: Q6. Are there positions available for Civil Engineering specializations?
faq.answer: Yes, vacancies include a Postdoc Position in Construction Materials requiring a Ph.D. in Construction Materials or allied fields, and a Post-Doctoral Research Fellow in Transportation/Pavement Engineering.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these fellowships?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham job portal, and applications can also be submitted by email to the designated address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type and location for these roles?
faq.answer: These positions are offered on a contract job type basis, and the successful candidates will be posted at Coimbatore in the state of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to these Postdoctoral Research Fellow positions at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to submit my application?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham at https://www.amrita.edu to access the portal and complete your online application process.
